findings.quote: Trend-followers hold their most extreme bet against ten-year Treasuries and German government debt in a year
findings.why: The JPMorgan Flows & Liquidity entry says momentum signals for 10y USTs and Bunds are at extreme short levels (-1.7 and -1.5 z-scores) and have 'moved back' to elevated short territory, with no one-year lookback window stated (the only 12-month extreme in the context is CTA positioning in HSI).
findings.fix: Drop 'in a year' and say the momentum signals are back at extreme short levels.

findings.quote: A month ago that same pricing carried cuts, so this is a reversal and not a trim.
findings.why: No entry in the context describes Fed pricing a month ago; Deutsche Bank only describes hawkish repricing of the rate path and an accelerating hiking cycle.
findings.fix: Cut the sentence or replace it with the supported point that the repricing pushed October hike odds to 71% and 37bp by year-end.

findings.quote: what is left on the table is export policy on semiconductors and the tariff path into 2027
findings.why: Nothing in the context ties semiconductor export policy to the Trump-Xi summit agenda; the only export-policy item in the corpus is the US diesel export ban, and the China entries cover only the two-month truce extension and tariff levels.
findings.fix: Limit the sentence to the tariff path, which the context supports, and remove the semiconductor export-policy claim.
